tasks.task: Confirm retirement eligibility, desired retirement date, TAFMS/service dates, ADSCs and likely retired grade.
Start retirement financial model: retired pay estimate, taxes, SBP, VA scenarios, health care, housing and relocation.
Begin TAP Initial Counseling as early as permitted and identify required Career Readiness Standards.
Identify post-retirement location(s), including overseas residency/visa implications if remaining OCONUS.
Create secure retirement document vault and master task tracker.
Inventory medical conditions, injuries, surgeries, medications, specialty care and missing records.
Begin civilian resume, LinkedIn/profile, certifications and transcript collection.
Submit retirement application when eligible under current Air Force process.
Begin/continue TAP requirements and selected career track.
Develop SkillBridge plan if participating; confirm eligibility, program, dates and command approval path.
Request or begin assembling copies of Service Treatment Records, dental records and relevant civilian records.
Review life insurance needs and compare SGLI conversion, VGLI and commercial options.
Identify expected terminal leave and permissive/administrative absence plan if authorized.
Review household goods and final-move entitlement concepts; identify likely destination.
Receive retirement approval/orders when available and review every data element for accuracy.
Use approved retirement date to lock SkillBridge, terminal leave, PTDY/absence and final duty-day sequence.
Start detailed VA claim preparation with a VSO/VA representative if desired.
Request missing imaging reports, operative reports, specialty notes and test results.
Schedule unresolved medical/dental issues early enough for treatment or documentation before departure.
Begin retirement ceremony planning and final award/decoration coordination if desired.
Gather letters of recommendation and non-duty contact information for references.
Confirm BDD eligibility and calculate the exact 180-day and 90-day claim-window dates.
Finalize claimed-condition list with onset, treatment locations, symptoms and supporting evidence.
Verify VA.gov access and personal contact information; never store passwords in the app.
Confirm Separation Health Assessment process with MTF/VA and required appointments.
Confirm SkillBridge and leave approvals/dependencies that affect availability for VA exams.
Review current TRICARE retiree plan options and expected costs for intended residence.
File VA Benefits Delivery at Discharge claim as soon as ready within the 180–90 day window, if eligible.
Submit Separation Health Assessment Part A as required for the BDD/separation health process.
Remain available for required VA C&P examinations and track every appointment.
Complete/continue retirement/separation health assessment appointments.
Request final comprehensive copies/exports of medical and dental records as they become available.
Begin detailed SBP education with spouse/family before making election.
Confirm final move/HHG counseling process after orders are available.
Continue C&P examinations and submit permitted evidence for pending VA claim.
Complete major TAP Career Readiness Standards and prepare for Capstone.
Review DD Form 2656 requirements: retired pay, direct deposit, tax withholding, beneficiaries and SBP.
Verify bank, personal email, phone and mailing address information that will remain valid after CAC loss.
Begin scheduling HHG shipment/NTS and final travel as appropriate.
Review housing termination/clearance requirements and utility cancellation dates.
BDD filing window closes at 90 days before separation/retirement; if not filed, transition to the appropriate standard VA claim process.
Finalize DD Form 2656 and SBP election; obtain spouse concurrence/notarization when required.
Complete TAP Capstone by the required deadline and resolve unmet standards.
Confirm retiree TRICARE enrollment actions, QLE window and family plan selection.
Plan DEERS update and retiree/dependent ID card appointments after retirement status posts.
Verify final active-duty pay, allotments, debts, travel vouchers and GTC status.
Confirm installation and unit out-processing start dates.
Start/continue installation and unit out-processing.
Clear or schedule clearance for CSS, security, equipment, records, training, facilities/keys, GTC and local agencies.
Turn in accountable government equipment/devices as allowed by mission timeline.
Complete housing pre-inspection/final inspection scheduling and move logistics.
Confirm HHG pack-out, pickup, storage and delivery details.
Refill medications and establish post-retirement medical continuity plan.
Obtain current eyeglass/contact prescriptions and needed durable-medical-equipment documentation.
Review DD Form 214 worksheet/source data and correct errors early.
Complete remaining unit/installation clearance items that can be closed before final duty day.
Complete security debrief/access termination requirements at the appropriate time.
Settle GTC and outstanding travel vouchers.
Complete official records/continuity turnover and handoff responsibilities.
Verify final evaluation and retirement decoration processing.
Verify DD Form 214 data: awards, deployments, military education, service dates and other entries.
Confirm final medical/dental record copies are safely archived outside government systems.
Confirm personal access to myPay, VA.gov and other post-service systems without relying solely on CAC.

sections.section: Final 14 days through final duty day

tasks.task: Complete final housing clearance/lease termination and utilities as applicable.
Complete MPF final out and all installation/unit out-processing.
Complete finance final out and understand final active-duty pay audit/hold.
Complete final equipment, badge, key, token and property turn-in.
Confirm final travel/HHG arrangements and retain receipts/inventories.
Preserve retirement orders, amendments, DD Form 2656, SBP election, final LES and key personnel documents.
Execute terminal leave/final duty transition as approved.

sections.relative_window: Final 14 days through final duty day

sections.section: Retirement date / first days after retirement

tasks.task: Verify retirement status has updated in DEERS.
Obtain retiree Uniformed Services ID card and eligible dependent cards.
Take required TRICARE enrollment action for retiree coverage.
Verify retired myPay account and retired-pay direct-deposit/tax data.
Obtain and securely archive final DD Form 214 when issued.
Update mailing address/contact information with DFAS, DEERS, VA and other required institutions.

sections.relative_window: Retirement date / first days after retirement

tasks.task: Verify first retired-pay account data and resolve discrepancies promptly.
Track VA claim status and respond to VA requests/exams.
Apply for/enroll in VA health care as appropriate.
Confirm TRICARE coverage for all eligible family members and resolve enrollment issues.
Complete FEDVIP dental/vision enrollment if desired/eligible within applicable enrollment rules.
Finalize VGLI/SGLI conversion or other life-insurance decision within applicable deadlines.
Confirm HHG delivery/storage claims and document loss/damage if applicable.
Ensure TRICARE QLE enrollment action is completed within the retirement window to avoid coverage problems.
Review VA rating decision when issued; verify dependents and effective dates.
Review retired pay/VA interaction and CRDP/CRSC eligibility if applicable.
Verify all final military records are archived: orders, DD214, DD2656, SBP, LES, medical/dental, evaluations, decorations and certificates.
Close remaining relocation, housing, travel and claims actions.
Maintain current DFAS, DEERS, VA and TRICARE contact information.
Review SBP, beneficiary, tax withholding and life-insurance information after major life events.
Maintain permanent copies of DD214, retirement orders, medical records and VA decisions.
Track VA appeals/supplemental claims or CRSC actions if needed.
Review annual TRICARE/FEDVIP enrollment and cost changes.
